# Core Requirements-Quality Checklist: Typing Core (F1)

**Purpose**: Gate G1. Audit whether F1's requirements are good enough to build six lanes against —
completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and coverage of the requirements themselves, not of
any implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus areas**, from the request: keyboard model and Unlock Order invariants · accuracy and error
counting (the requirements document's §8.1 and §8.2, the load-bearing lines) · the zero-peek
"not rendered at all" distinction · Mastery versus speed-never-gates · retention and store version ·
the guided session · offline after first load · scenario testability through text-input events ·
genuine independence of the six Independent Tests against the file-ownership table.
**Depth**: formal release gate. **Audience**: reviewer, before any lane opens.

## Keyboard Model & Unlock Order

- [ ] CHK001 Is "every supported key" bounded by an enumerable list, so that "exactly one finger" is checkable rather than open-ended? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the four keys the requirements' §2 tables omit — apostrophe, `ґ`, hyphen, digits — each assigned a finger in the requirements, and is the per-layout difference stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, research §R7]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the macOS position uncertainty for `ґ` and the apostrophe recorded as an open data question with an owner, rather than assumed? [Assumption, data-model §Key]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the initial unlocked set (the eight anchors plus space) stated as a requirement, not only in research, given that FR-012 restricts text to the unlocked set and the first scale needs all eight? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, research §R7]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it explicit that space is never unlocked and never in the Unlock Order, so "the unlocked set is a prefix" cannot be read as excluding space? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the requirements consistent about whether punctuation that sits physically on the home or bottom row unlocks with that row or with the punctuation group? [Consistency, research §R7]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the Shift rule — the pinky opposite the target character — stated in a form that can be evaluated for any shifted character, including characters whose own finger is a pinky? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "Transition" defined precisely enough to distinguish it from a bigram everywhere the requirements use both? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, CONTEXT.md]

## Accuracy & Error Counting — the load-bearing rules

- [ ] CHK009 Is "character keystroke" defined, so that the accuracy denominator is unambiguous about Backspace, modifiers, input-method events and dead keys? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK010 Do the requirements state accuracy's numerator as explicitly as its denominator, rather than leaving "correct keystrokes" to inference? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the requirement that a corrected error stays counted stated once and identically wherever it appears — functional requirement, Formulas page, Definition of Done — with no variant wording? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024, §FR-053 area, §US4]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the behaviour specified when the denominator would be zero (an attempt abandoned before any character keystroke)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are "errors by character" requirements clear about whether a wrong key is attributed to the character expected or the character typed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK014 Is `WPM = SPM / 5` stated with the definition of the "word" it implies, so the figure is reproducible by a reader of the Formulas page? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023, §US4]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the requirements' §8.1 fixed examples specified as a named, versioned set, rather than left to whoever writes the test? [Gap, Spec §Definition of Done 8]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it stated that an `ignored` event counts in neither the error total nor the denominator, so "must not break the session" is distinguishable from "is silently discarded"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]

## Zero-Peek

- [ ] CHK017 Is "not rendered at all — not merely hidden from view" expressed in a way a reviewer can evaluate without naming a technology? [Measurability, Spec §FR-037, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Are exactly four hidden elements enumerated, and is the list identical in the functional requirement, the acceptance scenario and the success criterion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037, §US1.5, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it stated which indicators deliberately stay visible (time, error count, progress) and why, so a future change cannot quietly hide one more? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the requirements clear that no claim of camera-free gaze verification is ever made, and is that phrased as a prohibition on the product's wording rather than only on its features? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038]

## Mastery, Unlocking & the Speed Rule

- [ ] CHK021 Is "three consecutive" defined against a scope — consecutive per exercise, per key, or per session — with no room for a second reading? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the reset condition complete: does a Practice Attempt between two passing Test Attempts break the run, or is it invisible to the count? [Gap, Spec §FR-039, §US3.5]
- [ ] CHK023 Is "speed never gates progression" stated strongly enough to cover Confidence, which contains a speed term and drives the Focus Element and the guide tier? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040, §FR-029, research §R4]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the accuracy floor a single determinate value in F1, and is the rule that produces it (level follows stage) stated as a requirement rather than only as an assumption? [Clarity, Spec §FR-080, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the requirements unambiguous about what unlocks when mastery is met on an exercise whose Focus Element is already unlocked? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK026 Is Stage 1 completion's "accuracy over the last five attempts" specified as to which attempts count — Test only, or Practice too, and across exercises or within one? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK027 Is "enough samples" for naming a Transition quantified in the requirements, not only in research? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035, research §R4]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the starting-level choice's effect specified in terms of the unlocked set boundary, so "forward only" is objectively checkable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-073]

## Persistence, Retention & Store Version

- [ ] CHK029 Is the retention rule explicit about what is *not* affected by pruning — progress, Confidence, history, every previously reported metric? [Completeness, Spec §FR-081, §SC-019]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for the result screen of an attempt whose keystroke log has been pruned, distinguishing "detail not kept" from "no data"? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Is "the 20 most recent attempts" unambiguous about ordering when two attempts share a completion timestamp? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Does the requirement for an unrecognised version marker specify the learner-facing outcome, not only that it must not be misread? [Completeness, Spec §FR-083]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the per-language separation of progress specified for every stored thing, or only for progress — where do Settings and history sit? [Gap, Spec §FR-051]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the concurrent-tab requirement measurable as written, given that it states only that stale state must not silently win? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements defined for the boundary between "storage unavailable" and "storage full", which have different learner-facing consequences? [Clarity, Spec §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK036 Is "progress is a fold in completion order" stated as a requirement on the result rather than on the algorithm, so it stays verifiable if the implementation changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-050]

## Offline After First Load

- [ ] CHK037 Is "basic training" bounded — which exercises must work offline, and does recording an attempt and reading its result count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-074]
- [ ] CHK038 Are requirements defined for the first visit itself, which by definition has no cache? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the documentation obligation ("anything that still needs the network") specified as a deliverable with a location, rather than an intention? [Measurability, Spec §FR-074]
- [ ] CHK040 Are requirements stated for a stale cached shell after a deployment, so an offline-capable app cannot serve an old build indefinitely? [Gap, Exception Flow]

## The Guided Session

- [ ] CHK041 Is the 15–25 minute bound specified with the quantity it is measured over — elapsed time, typing time, or target character count at a stated speed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-077]
- [ ] CHK042 Are the three blocks' contents specified precisely enough to be built, in particular what "the weakest Transitions of the previous session" means when sessions differ in length? [Clarity, Spec §FR-075]
- [ ] CHK043 Is "previous session" defined — the last completed session, the last started one, or the last one with attempts? [Ambiguity, Spec §US6.2, §US6.3]
- [ ] CHK044 Are requirements defined for a session interrupted by a browser restart rather than by a deliberate exit? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK045 Is the prohibition on a pseudo-word substitute for the real-text block consistent with the requirements' allowance of labelled pseudo-words in mechanics exercises? [Consistency, Spec §FR-076, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK046 Is it specified whether attempts inside a session count toward the Mastery Rule identically to attempts started from Path? [Gap, Spec §FR-079]

## Scenario Testability

- [ ] CHK047 Is every acceptance scenario written so its precondition can be established without depending on another story's screen? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios, plan §File Ownership]
- [ ] CHK048 Is the one CDP-only scenario identified identically in the spec and in the Definition of Done, with no second scenario silently needing a physical layout? [Consistency, Spec §US1.8, §Definition of Done 3]
- [ ] CHK049 Are scenarios phrased in terms of characters arriving rather than keys being pressed, given that the keyboard API cannot type Cyrillic? [Clarity, Spec §Definition of Done 4]
- [ ] CHK050 Is "nothing outside the typing line changes" specified with a scope for *when* it must hold — during an attempt only, or also across pause and resume? [Clarity, Spec §FR-069, §US1.9]
- [ ] CHK051 Is the latency requirement's measurement conditions stated in the requirements, or only in research, given that p95 ≤ 16 ms is meaningless without them? [Gap, Spec §FR-070, research §R8]
- [ ] CHK052 Are the acceptance scenarios for the frozen live metrics specified — what the rail shows during the very first attempt, when there is no last completed exercise? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-059]

## Lane Independence

- [ ] CHK053 Does every story's Independent Test depend only on its own owned paths plus Foundational, with no dependence on another lane's screen? [Consistency, plan §File Ownership]
- [ ] CHK054 Is US2's rendering of the Key Unlock card specified against store data rather than against US3's rule, so the two lanes are genuinely orderable either way? [Clarity, plan §File Ownership, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK055 Is the Next Action's presence on both Today and the result screen specified once, so US2 and US3 cannot implement two variants? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, §US3.8]
- [ ] CHK056 Are the Foundational phase's deliverables specified completely enough that a lane never discovers a missing shared module mid-flight? [Completeness, plan §File Ownership]
- [ ] CHK057 Is it specified which lane owns the navigation's disabled out-of-scope items, given that the shell is Foundational but the disabled state describes other features? [Gap, Spec §FR-055]

## Ambiguities, Conflicts & Assumptions to Resolve

- [ ] CHK058 Is the divergence from the requirements document's §5.3 row-change example recorded as a deliberate, published disagreement rather than an error, and is the obligation to publish both readings a requirement? [Conflict, Spec §US4.4]
- [ ] CHK059 Is the waiver of mandatory authentication recorded everywhere it must appear — plan, PR template, and the spec's scope boundary — with the same wording? [Consistency, plan §Waiver, Spec §Scope Boundary]
- [ ] CHK060 Is the self-hosted-fonts consequence of "no third parties, works offline" captured as a requirement rather than left as a plan-level inference? [Gap, Spec §FR-053, §FR-074, plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK061 Are the five glossary terms this feature introduces — Layout, Key, Scale, Level, Settings — scheduled for `CONTEXT.md`, so the domain model does not drift? [Traceability, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK062 Is the assumption that weak-element re-injection can be deferred to the plan validated, given that FR-046 requires the Focus Element in every item? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-046]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`; this file is not part of that lifecycle
- 62 items. Several are known findings rather than open questions — CHK027 (the sample threshold lives
  in research but not in the requirements) and CHK051 (likewise for the latency measurement
  conditions) were visible while writing this list, and CHK004, CHK024, CHK060 and CHK061 are the
  same shape: a decision that exists but sits in the wrong artifact. Those are the cheapest to close
  and should be closed before `/speckit-tasks` rather than after.
